title: Truck acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates truck's deceleration magnitude using v₁² = 2ax with given stopping distance.

title: Truck displacement before braking
description: Important: Computes truck's displacement during (t + Δt) using kinematics for uniform deceleration.

title: Car displacement before braking
description: Important: Computes car's displacement during (t + Δt) using uniform motion at v₀.

title: Separation at braking start
description: Essential: Correctly combines initial separation and displacements to find Δx when car begins braking.

title: Truck speed at braking start
description: Important: Calculates truck's speed when car starts braking using v₂ = v₁ - a(t + Δt).

title: Equal speed condition
description: Important: Sets up equation v₀ - a't' = v₂ - at' for time when speeds match.

title: Minimum acceleration condition
description: Essential: Applies equal-displacement-at-equal-speed condition to solve for minimum a'.

title: Sign/direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for accelerations (deceleration as positive/negative incorrectly).

title: Time interval errors
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect total time (t or t+Δt) in displacement/speed calculations.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout calculations and final answers.
